title: Loser, Baby

[00:00.000] 作词 : Andrew Underberg/Sam Haft
[00:00.304] 作曲 : Andrew Underberg/Sam Haft

[02:23.870]A loser but just maybe
[02:26.418]If we eat shit together

[02:34.830]Excuse yourself let hope in
[02:37.773]Baby play your card be who you are
[02:40.399]A loser just like me
